subject: Recap & next steps — Redwood + FinBox discovery
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@finbox.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & next steps — Redwood + FinBox discovery

Alex — thanks for the 30 today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared plan: 

Summary from call:
- Goal: evaluate Redwood Inference to serve FinBox’s real-time risk-scoring use case (latency target < 150 ms P95, 20k reqs/day).
- Primary constraints: PCI-adjacent data, need VPC/private deployment for production, SOC 2 + signed DPA.
- Success metric for pilot: 1-week latency stability + token-cost target within 30% of our estimate.

Owned next steps (suggested):
1) Redwood: send high-level pricing + pilot SOW, SOC 2 evidence, and a short playbook for POC network setup (ETA 48 hours). Attachment: pricing + quickstart.
2) FinBox: confirm internal stakeholder list (engineering + security) and target pilot date window (two-week window in Dec).
3) Procurement: we’ll share a redline-friendly SOW; happy to take a simplified MSA for pilot.

Proposed pilot kickoff windows: Dec 7–11 or Dec 14–18. If either works, we’ll lock calendar and prepare access details. 

Attachments: redwood-quickstart-mvp.pdf (high-level POC plan)

Thanks — I’ll loop in Rishi to handle contract questions.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-quickstart-mvp.pdf (pdf, 2 pages)]
